electronically to FinCEN.14 The Los Angeles Fashion District GTO was effective from
October 9, 2014 through April 6, 2015.

statutory.label: entailment
statutory.reasoning: Under 31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3), it is illegal to structure transactions to evade reporting requirements. The fact pattern shows multiple cash transactions totaling $272,544.94 (2026-04-10, 2026-03-11, 2026-04-15, 2026-03-30) that are each just below the $10,000 reporting threshold. While the entity is a BVI business, the use of cash to avoid triggering Currency Transaction Reports (CTRs) satisfies the elements of structuring under the statute. The conduct is consistent with evading reporting requirements as defined by 31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3).
